text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The time... has come.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Yes, the time had come.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My three years with Tanino Gimlet had ended,
and on a day spent going about my usual routine...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Time has——
choice_data_list: So you came.
So you came.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
It's an invitation to Valhalla.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Tanino Gimlet brought over
was something won from a lottery raffle――
choice_data_list: Hot spring trip tickets?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. For the heart of Dawn
had already raced ahead."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I arrived at the inn alongside
Tanino Gimlet, however...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
choice_data_list: (...Is it just me, or is it kind of quiet?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Usually, she would be much more talkative.
She didn't seem depressed, but as she lost herself in thought, her profile—
choice_data_list: (She looks more mature than usual—)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Until later, then.
For now... I shall simply bring joy to my neurons.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the look on your face,
it seems you had a truly blissful time.
choice_data_list: Is Gimlet... still thinking it over?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
So it reached you, huh."
choice_data_list: We've known each other for a long time, after all.
We've known each other for a long time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Enough to connect our synapses. We've spent such an intensely
deep and long time... together.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Out into the open.
The wind is waiting impatiently for us—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after stepping outside, Tanino Gimlet remains quiet.
Almost as if he's searching for the right moment
to broach the subject...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...It feels out of this world.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
After downing such a wonderful cocktail
and savoring every last bit of the aftertaste...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: What would you do?
choice_data_list: ...Shall we leave the shop?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Indeed, there's no need to linger.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
If you deem that cocktail to be supreme...
cast aside all lingering regrets and take your leave.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
If one is to cherish fleeting moments...
then one must also place value in farewells.
choice_data_list: (A parting...—)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —It is far too early for Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I somehow managed to understand her train of thought.
The words from the day we signed our contract, and
the meaning behind the repeated 'The time has come'...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —It is time for Gimlet.
choice_data_list: (Even so—I...)
(Even so—I...)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That is why, Trainer...
I... No, I—
choice_data_list: ...After Gimlet, what fine drink shall we have next?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Next... you say?
choice_data_list: Take those stars, for instance—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking up at the sky, she points at a star.
One by one, the shining stars
each cast their own unique brilliance.
choice_data_list: How would you do the twist?
How would you do the twist?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
choice_data_list: The next cup is sure to surpass that wonderful first one.
The next cup is sure to surpass that wonderful first one, won't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of denying her aesthetic.
Even so, if only I could hold her heart back
with my true, unfiltered feelings—
choice_data_list: I can... look forward to what's next, right?
I can... look forward to what's next, right?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...
Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —All things are one.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: If it is "us," then I suppose that is how it must be.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Kuku,
Bwahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, shall we give it a try?
A brand new recipe! A chalice dedicated to Galatea!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
After all, it is still far too early
for Gimlet!
choice_data_list: Gimlet...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer!
Follow me! I'll offer you the supreme cup!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The name of this cocktail, infused with crushed stars, is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond between
myself and Tanino Gimlet...
